definitions.explanation: A fraction whose numerator is equal to or larger than its denominator, so that its value is 1 or more — for example 5/3. It can always be rewritten as a {帯分数|たいぶんすう} (mixed number).

examples.japanese: {仮分数|かぶんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{帯分数|たいぶんすう}→帯分数：30693_taibunsuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直|なお}し⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Convert the improper fraction into a mixed number.

examples.japanese: かけ{算|ざん}や⟦{割|わ}り{算|ざん}→割り算：05335_warizan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{帯分数|たいぶんすう}→帯分数：30693_taibunsuu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{仮分数|かぶんすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧しやすい。
examples.english: When multiplying or dividing, improper fractions are easier to work with than mixed numbers.

notes:
{仮|か} (provisional, temporary) + ⟦{分数|ぶんすう}→分数：06952_bunsuu⟧ (fraction): a fraction only in form, since its value is not less than one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仮分数|かぶんすう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直|なお}す: to convert into an improper fraction
- {仮分数|かぶんすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧: to give the answer as an improper fraction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真分数|しんぶんすう}→真分数：30691_shinbunsuu⟧: proper fraction — numerator smaller than the denominator
- ⟦{帯分数|たいぶんすう}→帯分数：30693_taibunsuu⟧: mixed number — the same value written as a whole number plus a fraction
- ⟦{分数|ぶんすう}→分数：06952_bunsuu⟧: fraction — the general term
